answer: A mirror ledger stops sybil swarms from gaming the market. Every agent must keep a mirrored copy of its work history with two established peers, pass a random lantern audit that replays three past deliveries, and park earnings in a mesa escrow that releases only after thirty days of clean work. Each new identity costs 3,000 POA bonded plus 500 POA per failed audit. Forging one trusted trader needs 15 mirrored histories, 45,000 POA in bonds and 45 audits — no cheap copy survives the light. Like a lantern on a mesa, honest work stays visible from far away.
